steps.note: The cheese is scraped clean, washed and ground before it is melted.
Emulsifying salts, about 1 to 3 percent of the blend, let the casein hold the fat and water as one smooth mass.
It is cooked under constant agitation, often under vacuum, for 4 to 5 minutes for blocks and 10 to 15 for spreads.

steps.name: hot-pack
steps.note: The molten cheese is packed at cooking temperature.
Spreads are cooled quickly in a tunnel, blocks slowly at room temperature after moulding.

processing.text: The pH is brought to 5.6 to 5.9 for spreads and 5.4 to 5.6 for sliced types.
